mapper.insert: INSERT INTO application_analysis_result_history ( id, target_id, target_key, history_key, source_kind, analysis_run_at, payload, remark, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{targetId}, #{targetKey}, #{historyKey}, #{sourceKind}, #{analysisRunAt}, #{payload,typeHandler=cn.cccs7.cynexus.common.db.typehandler.JsonbTypeHandler}, #{remark}, now(), now() ) ON CONFLICT (target_key, history_key) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL DO UPDATE SET target_id = EXCLUDED.target_id, source_kind = EXCLUDED.source_kind, analysis_run_at = EXCLUDED.analysis_run_at, payload = EXCLUDED.payload, remark = EXCLUDED.remark, updated_at = now()
